description: This file defines the Element class with helper methods for Drupal render elements, including property checks, child element identification, visibility determination, attribute setting, and render array validation.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for managing Drupal render elements.

methods.name: property
methods.description: Checks if a key is a property (starts with '#').

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Retrieves property keys (starting with '#') from an element array.

methods.name: child
methods.description: Checks if a key represents a child element (not starting with '#').

methods.name: children
methods.description: Identifies child elements, optionally sorted by weight.

methods.name: getVisibleChildren
methods.description: Returns keys of visible child elements.

methods.name: isVisibleElement
methods.description: Determines if an element is visible based on type and access.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets HTML attributes based on element properties.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an element is considered empty (only has #cache or #weight).

methods.name: isRenderArray
methods.description: Validates if a variable is a render array.
